items.caption: This seal-script-style redraw shows traditional 館. Shuowen analyzes it as 食 with 官 providing the sound, a traditional account of the graph’s structure.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style form of 館, with the 食 component on the left and 官 on the right, on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It gives a clear visual example of the traditional 館 structure described in the cited dictionary accounts. It is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact.

limitations.text: This form illustrates the traditional dictionary analysis of 館; it does not establish the history of the earlier 宛 lodging graph or a sequence connecting the two forms.
The target character is simplified 馆. The cited sources identify it as simplified from 館 but do not date when this exact 饣 form was standardized.
